dataset: National Heritage List for England NHLE v02 / Listed Building polygons (FeatureServer layer 3)
license: Open Government Licence; service copyright states Crown Copyright 2026 and Ordnance Survey data copyright/database right 2026
evidence_slice: Historic England's official 2026 National Heritage List for England NHLE v02 FeatureServer exposes layer 3 'Listed Building polygons' as an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer. The layer supports JSON, GeoJSON and PBF query formats and exposes record-bound fields including ListEntry, Name, Grade, CaptureScale, hyperlink, NGR, Easting and Northing. The selected new source window queried the Exeter envelope 287000,88000,299000,99000 in EPSG:27700, requested at most 50 records, returnGeometry=true and outSR=4326. The web retrieval channel could not access the parameterized response, and a separate direct network attempt failed during DNS resolution before any feature payload was read. No polygon or record attribute was inferred or fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Official layer metadata declares esriGeometryPolygon and the selected query requested returnGeometry=true, but no Exeter feature payload or polygon coordinates were retrievable.
field_evidence.type_use: Official layer metadata exposes a Name field bound to each polygon feature, but no record-specific Name/type-use value was readable from the blocked Exeter bbox response.
field_evidence.heritage: Official layer metadata exposes ListEntry, Grade, hyperlink and NGR fields bound to listed-building polygon features; no record-specific payload was readable from the blocked Exeter bbox response.
